description:
The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

The space
Inside “Marbella Nashville”

-This is a beautiful apartment with all high end finishes you’d expect.

Interior Features:
-9-foot ceiling, designer lighting, high end window furnishings, wood-style plank flooring, nest thermostats, hard wood floors, ceiling fans,stainless steel appliances, views and modern finishes.

Master Bedroom:
-King Size bed in master bedroom with XL pillows/throws, also features 
walk in closets..there’s a separate door in the bedroom that leads to its own private bathroom which features a bath and a glass door stand 

in shower. 
 There’s also Netflix ready 40 inches TV in room. 

Bedroom 2:
-Features  a Queen and Full size and a roll away bed. This room has its own walk in closet and a private bathroom.
Note-There is also an extra Rollaway bed for additional guest. 

Living Room:
-Equipped with a Alexa ready 60-inch Smart TV,Fast/high speed internet, nest thermostat, lamps, plants, high end decor and modern furniture.

Kitchen:

countertop / island, refrigerator with freezer/ice
